_README: Drives the shareable link preview (OG/Twitter tags in index.html), applied by scripts/apply-eval-preview.py via the eval-preview GitHub Action. EVERGREEN shows by default. To run an eval: set eval.activeUntil to the eval DATE (end of day, Central), point eval.image at a fresh card (bump its filename to bust the Facebook cache), set the copy, and push. It shows until that date, then auto-reverts to evergreen. A past activeUntil is inert.
